unknown.title: The schema does not know this node
unknown.description: A form cannot be built from it, but it is kept byte for byte and goes to the device as is. That happens when sing-box on the device is newer than the form schema: the schema is not entitled to forbid what sing-box accepts.

conditions.unknown: Conditions are not shown: the schema does not know the fields of this rule. They can be read and edited on the JSON tab.
conditions.empty: No conditions — the rule applies to all traffic and ends the list.
conditions.group: Logical rule: conditions are joined by «{{mode}}» in nested branches. They can be read and edited on the JSON tab.
conditions.inverted: The condition is inverted: the rule fires when it does not hold.
